label: D2 rare a2->S1 after a rewarded a2 trial, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S1 (a rare transition). This necessary condition gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.21. All activations are on stay trials (previous choice also a2, or the first trial in the window), 90% of mass follows a rewarded previous trial, and nearly all fall in the policy-logit band choice in (-8.9, -4.4), i.e. a moderately confident a2 preference. Activity depends strongly on position in the episode: none before trial ~20, rising through trials 60-89, and dropping at 90-99. This looks like slow hidden-state drift pushing the candidate value across the threshold, so the episode-time window is a proxy, not a task variable. Everything in the predicate is observed at D2 (action, reached state, previous trial). Does not fire at D1 or GO, on S2 arrivals, or on a1 choices. Test F1 is limited because the unit sits near its threshold, and many qualifying steps stay just below it.
